title: Dungeons and Dynasties
description:
Dungeons and Dynasties is a free, single-player guild-management game, a blend of Darkest Dungeon, Football Manager-style sports management and the atmosphere of A Dark Room. You run an entire adventuring guild: send four heroes on delves for coin (battles play out automatically, and you can follow them), compete in trials every few days for renown and a place in the league table, and enter exhibitions and cups. Your heroes have quirks and flaws: a greedy one may put on cursed armour instead of carrying it home, a restless one may stop the party resting. Party members form bonds that affect their stats. Your guild has a hall, an armoury, a training ground, staff to hire and heroes to pay, and a patron; you can customise it at its founding or take up the history of one the game makes for you, while computer-controlled guilds climb the same leagues.

Events and tutorials appear at the top of the window; the rest is standard menus. Accessibility fixes go to the browser version first.
